items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He and I would play cards together.

ctx.x: I’ve heard that – and we’ll talk about this in a moment, but I wanted to explore this side first – I’ve heard that your adopted parents – was your mother a registered nurse, and father was a chef on the railroad?
Absolutely, and a good chef. Uncle Joe. That’s what they called him.
That’s what they called him. And did you call him Uncle Joe, or Daddy, or what?
